categories.name: Activate the shipped AI layers in production

items.title: Elevated QI_MapSnap restart
items.detail: Phases 2-4 (data profiling _profile_block, hybrid semantic retrieval, verified-query recording) are coded but read at runtime; an admin (elevated) restart of the QI_MapSnap NSSM service flips them from Partial to Live.

items.title: Settings UI for data policy + enrichment grid
items.detail: Surface the per-profile data_policy selector and the layer x trigger enrichment grid in build_browser.py. Server enforcement is already authoritative; this is presentation only.

items.title: Extend the regression eval set
items.detail: Grow the NL->SQL / chat eval suite (model_eval.py) to cover 'what kind of data is in <column>' and 'what values are in <column>' answered from real masked samples.

items.title: Live-data value catalog for non-OnBase engines
items.detail: Generalise Layer 3: a profiling-driven catalog for any lookup-heavy schema, not just OnBase DocTypes/keywords, so business-name resolution works on Jenzabar and others.

items.title: Per-system domain packs beyond OnBase / Jenzabar
items.detail: Flesh out the existing system_docs stubs (peoplesoft, banner, sap, epic, blackbaud, dynamics365) with real primers and domain rules.

items.title: Background-job UI for heavy enrichment
items.detail: Show 'Enriching - N/2,325 tables' progress and re-embed-on-completion for the budgeted LLM-heavy layers, keeping Connect & Extract responsive.

items.title: Point the stack at Boston University's connection
items.detail: The whole pipeline is engine-agnostic by design; reuse it for CogniBase by pointing at BU's OnBase/SQL connection. Only domain packs and catalog are tuned per system.

items.title: Institutional cloud-tenancy model routing
items.detail: Support running the frontier model via the institution's own AWS Bedrock / Azure OpenAI / Vertex tenancy under their DPA/BAA, in addition to local-only and metadata-only.

items.title: Federation onboarding: canonical-key mapping proposals
items.detail: Per BU Library v2 Appendix A + Doc 18: point MapSnap at each structured system of record (SAP/BUworks, MyBU/Campus Solutions, CAMMS, StarRez, ...), read the schema, and propose canonical-key mappings (e.g. 'SAP vendor key ≡ canonical PersonTaxID'). Those proposals become candidate Normalizers that CogniBase consumes and a steward ratifies — MapSnap builds the ontology CogniBase governs.

items.title: Pre-ingestion augmentation (AutoPDF + MapSnap, Phase 0 / optional)
items.detail: Per Appendix A: resolve AutoPDF-extracted document fields to canonical entities/keys using MapSnap value catalogs at capture time, so OnBase content arrives pre-aligned (canonical key + confidence + provenance). Discovery family as one pipeline: capture (AutoPDF) → understand (MapSnap) → align → correlate (CogniBase). Exploratory; not required for the core pilot.

items.title: Cross-profile verified-query sharing
items.detail: Optionally promote high-value verified NL->SQL pairs into reusable templates across similar schemas of the same system type.

items.title: Schema-change watch + auto re-enrich
items.detail: Detect schema.json mtime changes and incrementally re-profile / re-embed only what changed, with a background re-embed tail.

items.title: Exportable schema confirmation packet
items.detail: One-click export of the schema map, relationships, and annotations as a shareable report for stakeholder sign-off.
